description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessSourcer class, which appears to generate access modifiers for Java classes or methods based on OPCodes flags.

classes.name: AccessSourcerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the functionality of AccessSourcer, focusing on the generated access modifier strings based on Opcodes flags.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the StringWriter and AccessSourcer instances before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Nullifies the StringWriter and AccessSourcer instances after each test.

methods.name: testAbstractPublic
methods.description: Tests whether AccessSourcer generates 'public abstract' string when given ACC_ABSTRACT and ACC_PUBLIC flags.

methods.name: testPrivateFinalStatic
methods.description: Tests whether AccessSourcer generates 'private static final' string when given ACC_PRIVATE, ACC_FINAL, and ACC_STATIC flags.
